eyecross.hud.parallel: Near-parallel trails, throw from a new spot
eyecross.chat.solution: Estimated stronghold: X=%s, Z=%s (%s blocks away, %s trails, RMS error %s)
eyecross.chat.single_estimate: Single-throw estimate: the stronghold is on ring %s (%s strongholds on this ring), about X=%s, Z=%s (%s blocks away, ±%s blocks). Throw one more for an exact fix.
eyecross.chat.estimate_out_of_range: This direction crosses no stronghold ring, so a single-throw estimate isn't possible. Throw again closer to the origin (X=0, Z=0).
eyecross.chat.ring_of_solution: This point lies on ring %s (ring radius %s–%s blocks; %s strongholds on this ring).
eyecross.chat.not_in_any_ring: Note: this point is %s blocks from the origin, outside every stronghold ring (possibly trail error or the eyes pointed at different strongholds).
eyecross.chat.high_residual: Residuals are large; consider throwing one more eye.
eyecross.chat.parallel: These trails are nearly parallel and cannot intersect. Move a good distance away (in a different direction) and throw again.
eyecross.chat.trail_too_short: Trail too short (the eye broke close by); ignored. Throw again.
eyecross.chat.trail_degenerate: Degenerate trail; could not fit a line. Throw again.
eyecross.chat.need_two: At least 2 trails are needed to compute an intersection.
eyecross.chat.rings_header: Stronghold rings (centered on the world origin X=0, Z=0):
eyecross.help.cmd_status: /eyecross status — show recorded trails, the single-throw estimate and the exact fix
eyecross.help.cmd_rings: /eyecross rings — list the stronghold ring layout
eyecross.help.cmd_reset: /eyecross reset — clear all trails and results
eyecross.help.cmd_hudpos: /eyecross hudpos topleft|topright|bottomleft|bottomright — set the HUD screen corner
eyecross.help.footer: How to use the mod (throwing eyes) is described in the README.
